title: A Technique to Model Product Information and User Reviews (MPIUR)
abstract: arXiv:2611.13361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern e-commerce platforms naturally provide three complementary modalities: textual item descriptions, item images, and user reviews. However, existing multimodal recommendation methods often omit reviews or do not integrate all three modalities within a unified framework. In this paper, we propose MPIUR, a multimodal graph-based recommendation model that encodes reviews in heterogeneous graphs, aligns image and text representations, and adapts collaborative--semantic alignment to item interaction density. Experiments on the Amazon Reviews 2023 Musical Instruments and Baby categories show that MPIUR achieves the best global nDCG@10 and Recall@10 among the evaluated methods on both datasets. It also obtains the best nDCG@10 and Recall@10 on sparse items, indicating that jointly exploiting reviews and multimodal item content is particularly useful when interaction histories are limited.

translated_title: 一种对商品信息与用户评论建模的技术
translated_abstract: 现代电商平台天然提供三种互补的模态：文本形式的商品描述、商品图片以及用户评论。然而，现有的多模态推荐方法往往忽略评论，或者未能在一个统一框架内整合这三种模态。本文提出了MPIUR，这是一个基于图的多模态推荐模型，它在异构图中对评论进行编码，对齐图像与文本表示，并根据商品交互密度自适应地调整协同—语义对齐。在Amazon Reviews 2023的乐器和母婴两个品类上的实验表明，MPIUR在所评估的方法中于两个数据集上均取得了最佳的全局nDCG@10和Recall@10。它还在稀疏商品上获得了最佳的nDCG@10和Recall@10，这表明当交互历史有限时，联合利用评论与多模态商品内容尤为有效。
tldr: 提出MPIUR多模态图推荐模型，将用户评论编码进异构图并对齐图文表示，在交互历史稀疏的场景下也能显著提升推荐性能（nDCG@10与Recall@10）。
en_tdlr: MPIUR is a multimodal graph-based recommendation model that encodes user reviews into heterogeneous graphs and aligns image-text representations, achieving the best nDCG@10 and Recall@10, especially on sparse items with limited interaction history.
